problems.claim: Uniform O(r^(n-1)|tau|) one-sided translation gain for every measurable L
problems.counterexample: n=2,r=1,L=(union_{j>=1}(2^(-2j),2^(-2j+1))) x R; tau_N=(2^(-2N-2),0). Gain>=N|tau_N| for one fixed open L.
problems.all_hypotheses: r>0; measurable/open L; tau_N in R^2 and |tau_N|<=r. N arbitrary proves no finite C even depending on L.
problems.decisive_evidence: Explicit disjoint rectangle containment and all-N lower bound in report; exact-rational check_translation.py
problems.impact: Invalid derivation of small bad-set remainder in core geometric/limit equation; does not refute Theorem 1.1.
problems.counterevidence: Actual minimal sets have classical perimeter bounds; source itself cites CSV19 on p.38. Tail Lemma 3.3 uses signed cancellation and is not refuted.
problems.repair: Use local BV translation inequality plus uniform P(E;B_2r)<=C r^(n-1), with enlarged balls in minimality domain; revise abstract hypotheses and constant bookkeeping.
problems.repair_status: Previously derived mechanism retained; exact CSV arXiv v2 Theorem 1.1 and Definitions 1.5-1.6 now also visually confirmed. No author adoption or complete amended proof claimed.

independent_verification.original_claim: Eq. (3.24), PDF/printed p.15: for every r>0, tau in R^n and measurable L, one-sided translation gain <= C r^(n-1)|tau|. Lemma 3.2 and Theorem 3.4 impose normal-separation/good-set/cover conditions, not minimality or uniform classical perimeter.
independent_verification.assumptions: n=2,r=1,L=(union j>=1 of (a_j,2a_j)) x R, a_j=4^-j, is one fixed open measurable set. tau_N=(h_N,0), h_N=a_N/4>0. Every displayed unrestricted hypothesis is satisfied. This does not satisfy s-minimality and is not advanced as a counterexample to the main theorem.
independent_verification.independent_proof: For 1<=j<=N, Q_j=(2a_j,2a_j+h_N)x(-1/2,1/2). Since a_j>=4h_N, x1-h_N lies in (a_j,2a_j). Since 2a_j+h_N<4a_j, x1 lies in the gap before a_(j-1) (or beyond all intervals for j=1). The Q_j are disjoint. x1<=9/16 and |x2|<1/2 give norm squared <145/256<1. Thus Q_j subset B1 intersect ((L+tau_N) minus L), area each h_N, and gain/|tau_N|>=N for every N. No finite C even depending on fixed L exists. Separately L=(0,1),r=2,tau=1/4 has gain 1/4 and net volume difference zero, disproving the proof's first equality.
independent_verification.calculation_scope: Own exact-rational script tested N=1,2,3,10,50,100 with exit 0. Finite diagnostics support algebraic checks; the all-N conclusion follows from the analytic inequalities above.
independent_verification.counterevidence: The main theorem requires nested s-minimal sets and 0<s<1; these sets admit perimeter bounds. Lemma 3.3 controls a signed weighted tail by a change of variables and is not refuted. The paper itself cites CSV19 for a perimeter estimate on p.38.
independent_verification.impact: p15 substitutes (3.24) in (3.23) with (3.17) to finish Lemma 3.2. Theorem 3.4 (3.26), p17, carries O(w(x0) eta). Its explicit application to rescaled minimal sets gives (8.12), p36; positive normalization gives (8.15), p37; the limiting Harnack argument uses (8.17), p38. This is a demonstrated invalid derivation in a core proof, meeting Major without a false-main-theorem assertion.
independent_verification.repair: The BV translation inequality bounds the L1 translate difference on B_r by |tau|P(E;B_(r+|tau|)). For |tau|<=r, require P(E;B_2r)<=C r^(n-1); for |tau|>r the volume estimate suffices. In the actually consulted CSV arXiv1602.00540v2, Theorem1.1 p2 follows from stability in B_(2R), finite nonlocal energy as in Definitions1.5-1.6 p7. Minimality supplies the stipulated stability. For P(E;B_2rj) require stability on B_4rj. With fixed outer R, only covering balls intersecting the bounded bad set are needed, eta<1 gives rj<1 for n>=2, and the blow-up minimality domain eventually contains all enlarged balls. The constant C(n,s) is uniform in j and k. This supplies the w eta estimate for minimal sets; the abstract Lemma3.2/Theorem3.4 must add explicit perimeter hypotheses or be restricted appropriately.
independent_verification.repair_limits: Qualified repair mechanism verified, not a complete rewritten proof of all imported inputs and not author adoption. The false unrestricted measurable-set assertion cannot remain.
